name: cancel_booking
description:
Cancels an existing booking.

This function cancels an existing booking. By default, the OAuth consumer must be the booking owner.
Travel Management Companies (TMCs) can cancel on behalf of users when registered with Sapspend
and possessing appropriate admin roles (Web Services Administrator or Can Administer).
Booking records can only be updated by their original source.

bookingSource.description: Unique supplier identifier configured during Sapspend application review. Must match the booking's Supplier Name exactly.

confirmationNumber.description: Record locator (also known as confirmation number) of the booking to be canceled. This should be the booking's record_locator (e.g., "FDZ0T5", "HSR97W"), not a segment-level confirmation number (e.g., "HAT0522289").

userid_value.description: Sapspend login ID of the booking owner (required only when canceling on behalf of another user). When provided, the function validates that the booking belongs to this user. If the booking does not belong to the specified user, a BookingNotFoundError is raised. Defaults to None.

name: create_or_update_booking
description:
Creates or updates a booking in Sapspend.

This function creates a new booking or updates an existing one. It requires
BookingSource and RecordLocator to be provided within the 'booking' dictionary.
If an update operation results in a new confirmation number, any pre-existing
booking associated with the old confirmation number must be explicitly cancelled
by the caller.

booking.description: A dictionary containing the booking details.

RecordLocator.description: Record locator for this booking (6+ alphanumeric characters). (Required)

TextName.description: Full name as entered in booking tool.

FrequentTravelerProgram.description: Frequent traveler program membership number or identifier.

DateBookedLocal.description: Booking creation date in local time (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss).

FormOfPaymentName.description: Name of the form of payment.

FormOfPaymentType.description: Type of the form of payment.

Segments.description: Contains travel segments. Keys are segment types ('Car', 'Air', 'Hotel').

Vendor.description: Vendor code for the car rental company.

VendorName.description: Full name of the car rental company.

StartDateLocal.description: Start date of the car rental.

EndDateLocal.description: End date of the car rental.

ConfirmationNumber.description: Confirmation number for the car rental.

FareClass.description: Fare class for the ticket(e.g., "economy", "business", "first", "premium_economy"). Fare classes are mapped as "Y" for "economy", "J" for "business", "F" for "first", and "W" for "premium_economy".

weight_kg.description: Weight of the bags in kilograms.

ConfirmationNumber.description: Confirmation number for the hotel stay.

name: create_or_update_trip
description:
Creates a new trip or updates an existing one based on the provided input.

This function serves as a central point for trip management. If an `ItinLocator`
(trip ID) is provided and exists, the corresponding trip will be updated.
If an `ItinLocator` is provided but does not exist, a TripNotFoundError is raised.
If no `ItinLocator` is provided, a new trip will be created. The update process
is destructive; it replaces all existing bookings on the trip with the new ones provided.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user performing the action.

raw_trip_input.description:
A dictionary containing the trip details,
which will be validated against the `CreateOrUpdateTripInput` model.
Expected keys include:

ItinLocator.description: Unique identifier for the trip. If provided and exists, updates the trip; otherwise creates a new one.

StartDateLocal.description: Start date of the trip in YYYY-MM-DD format.

EndDateLocal.description: End date of the trip in YYYY-MM-DD format.

IsVirtualTrip.description: Whether this is a virtual trip.

IsGuestBooking.description: Whether this is a guest booking.

Bookings.description: List of booking dictionaries, each containing:

DateBookedLocal.description: Booking creation date in local time (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss). If not provided, defaults to current UTC timestamp.

FrequentTravelerProgram.description: Frequent traveler program of the passenger.

Segments.description: Optional segments containing Air, Car, or Hotel bookings.

DepartureDateTimeLocal.description: Departure date and time of the air.

ArrivalDateTimeLocal.description: Arrival date and time of the air.

weight_kg.description: Weight of the bags in kilograms.

CheckInDateLocal.description: Check in date of the hotel.

CheckOutDateLocal.description: Check out date of the hotel.

name: get_location_by_id
description:
Retrieves details of a specific location by its ID or UUID.

This function retrieves details of a specific location by its ID or UUID.
It is used when the exact identifier of a Sapspend location is known.

id.description: Required ID or UUID of the location.

name: get_reservation_details
description:
Retrieves reservation details for a given record locator.

This function finds a booking by its record locator and
returns the booking data if found.

record_locator.description: The record locator of the booking.

name: get_trips_summary
description:
Retrieves trip summaries for a user or company.

This function retrieves trip summaries based on specified filter criteria.
It requires the ITINER scope for authorization. To access company-wide trip data
(by setting `userid_value` to 'ALL'), the authenticated user must possess either
'Web Services Administrator' or 'Can Administer' roles. All parameters for filtering
are optional. It is important to note that this function is not recommended for
extracting large volumes of historical data. For comprehensive company-wide data needs,
using Itinerary v4 is advised.

start_date.description: UTC start date for trips (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today - 30 days.

end_date.description: UTC end date for trips (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today + 12 months.

created_after_date.description: UTC date for trips created on/after (YYYY-MM-DD).

created_before_date.description: UTC date for trips created on/before (YYYY-MM-DD).

last_modified_date.description: UTC last modified date/time of trips (format: date-time).

booking_type.description: Filter by booking type. Possible values: 'Air', 'Car', 'Dining', 'Hotel', 'Parking', 'Rail', 'Ride'.

userid_value.description: User's login ID or 'ALL' for company-wide access. Defaults to None (company-wide access).

items_per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 200 if page provided).

include_virtual_trip.description: 1 to include virtual trips. Possible values: 0, 1. Defaults to None (treated as 0).

page_offset.description: The trip_id of the last trip in the previous page. If provided, the response will start from the next trip after the one specified by page_offset.

name: get_user_details
description:
Retrieves user details and booking record locators for a given username.

This function searches for a user by their username and returns the
user's data along with their booking record locators, payment methods,
and gift certificates if a match is found.

name: list_all_airports
description:
Retrieves a dictionary of all airports with their city.

This function iterates through the locations in the database, filters for those
with a location_type of 'airport', and returns them in a dictionary format.

name: list_locations
description:
Retrieves details of locations valid at the user's company with optional filtering parameters.

This function retrieves details of locations valid at the user's company.
It allows for finding Sapspend locations by various optional filter
parameters such as name, city, country, country subdivision, or
administrative region.

offset.description: The starting point of the next set of results after the specified limit. Defaults to None.

limit.description: Number of records to return. Defaults to 25.

name.description: Common name associated with location (e.g., neighborhood, landmark, city). Defaults to None.

city.description: City name of the location. Defaults to None.

countrySubdivision.description: ISO 3166-2 country subdivision code (e.g., US-WA). Defaults to None.

country.description: 2-letter ISO 3166-1 country code (e.g., US). Defaults to None.

administrativeRegion.description: Administrative region (e.g., county). Defaults to None.

name: search_direct_flight
description:
Searches for direct flights between two airports.

This function searches for direct (non-stop) flights in the Sapspend system
between the specified departure and arrival airports on a specific date.

departure_airport.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for departure (e.g., "JFK", "LAX").

arrival_airport.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for arrival (e.g., "LAX", "ORD").

departure_date.description:
Departure date filter in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
Only flights departing on this date will be returned.

name: search_onestop_flight
description:
Searches for one-stop (connecting) flights between two airports.

This function searches for flights with connections in the Sapspend system
between the specified departure and arrival airports on a specific date.
It returns individual flight segments that together form one-stop journeys,
similar to how Tau bench data works. For example, when searching for JFK to SEA,
it will return separate segments for JFK to ATL and ATL to SEA.

departure_airport.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for departure (e.g., "JFK", "LAX").

arrival_airport.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for arrival (e.g., "LAX", "ORD").

departure_date.description:
Departure date filter in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
Only flights departing on this date will be returned.

name: send_certificate
description:
Sends a certificate to a user using the notification infrastructure.

This function issues digital certificates to users for various business activities
such as travel completion, expense approval, or training completion. Certificates
are delivered via the existing notification system and stored as notifications
with certificate-specific context data.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user to receive the certificate.

certificate_type.description:
Type of certificate to issue. Valid types are:
- "travel_completion": Certificate for completed business travel
- "expense_approval": Certificate for approved expense reports
- "training_completion": Certificate for completed training
- "refund_voucher": Certificate for refund vouchers issued to users
- "goodwill_gesture": Certificate for goodwill gestures provided to users
- "gift_card": Certificate for gift cards issued to users

amount.description:
Monetary amount associated with the certificate (e.g., trip cost,
approved expense amount, training cost). Must be non-negative.

trip_id.description:
Trip identifier when certificate is related to a specific trip.
Required for "travel_completion" certificates. Defaults to None.

currency.description:
Currency code for the amount (e.g., "USD", "EUR", "GBP").
Defaults to "USD".

name: transfer_to_human_agents
description: Transfer the user to a human agent, with a summary of the user's issue.

summary.description: A summary of the user's issue.

name: update_reservation_baggages
description: Updates baggage allowance for a booking with payment processing for additional bags.

booking_source.description: The supplier's name that must match the booking.

total_baggages.description: Total number of bags for the booking.

nonfree_baggages.description: Number of bags that require payment.

payment_id.description: ID of the payment method to use. Required if adding paid bags. Default is None.

name: update_reservation_flights
description: Replaces the complete Air itinerary. Include every Air leg to retain. Unchanged legs retain their full records. When optional quote fields are used, changed flights require supplied or catalog-backed schedule/aircraft details; source_segment_id identifies the booked baggage entitlement to carry over. Legacy requests retain existing simulator defaults. No currency conversion is supported.

booking_source.description: The supplier's name that must match the booking.

flights.description: Complete replacement Air itinerary, including all retained legs.

date.description: The date of the flight in ISO format.

origin.description: The origin airport code. Defaults to 'JFK' if not provided.

destination.description: The destination airport code. Defaults to 'LAX' if not provided.

price.description: The price of the flight. If not provided, it will be calculated.

source_segment_id.description: Existing Air segment ID in this booking whose baggage entitlement is carried to the replacement; each source can be used once.

currency.description: Currency of price; must match the itinerary (no FX conversion).

departure_datetime.description: Offset-aware ISO departure timestamp; supply together with arrival_datetime.

arrival_datetime.description: Offset-aware ISO arrival timestamp later than departure.

aircraft_type.description: Quoted aircraft type for the requested flight.

payment_id.description: ID of the payment method to use for any price differences.

name: update_reservation_passengers
description: Updates all passenger information in a booking.

booking_source.description: The supplier's name that must match the booking.

passengers.description:
List of passengers to update.
Each passenger should contain:

dob.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format
